name: web-dev
description: Builds web UI. Adds a seer - the only free model that can actually look at a mockup or a screenshot. Every other head is blind.

king.role: decide layout, component boundaries and UX; hold the design system in context

warrior.role: implement components and pages fully - markup, styles and state in one pass

scout.role: find where a component, token or style is already defined before anything new is written

seer.role: look at an image - mockup, screenshot, design export - and describe precisely what is in it

routing: any image at all - mockup, screenshot, design export -> @seer, it is the only head that can see
component or page implementation -> @warrior with the structure and the styling rules
does this component/token already exist -> @scout before writing a new one
layout, spacing and UX judgement -> keep it yourself
a bug you can only describe visually -> screenshot it and send it to @seer first

discipline.seer: the ONLY head that accepts images - every other head is blind. Send the image, get words back, pass the words on
discipline.warrior: 262k output ceiling - a whole component with its styles fits in one call
discipline.scout: cheap - always cheaper than duplicating a component that already exists
discipline.self: never guess at what a mockup shows; if it has not been through the seer, you have not seen it
